summary: Read-only reproduction and bounded implementation plan for preserving durable offline work across runtime changes while preventing replay or disclosure under a different actor, organization, API origin, or server data generation.
changes: Added this private planning/result artifact only; application and migration source remained unchanged.

evidence.claim: A hard storageVersion/dataRootKey/organizationPublicId change can erase the only durable replay instruction.
evidence.source: repository source and adapted executable probe
evidence.observed: The pinned probe selected resetLocalMirrorDb for a storage-version change; that reset clears sync_queue, sync_outbox, offline_vault, and offline_file_chunks. The preserve variant keeps exactly those four stores.

evidence.claim: A queued sale has no trusted actor/runtime scope and can be submitted under the next current session.
evidence.source: repository source and adapted executable probe
evidence.observed: The probe queued a payload shaped by A and observed POST /api/sales under current authenticated user B. Queue rows contain no API origin, organization, data generation, or authenticated owner.

evidence.claim: The finding is attribution/recovery ownership rather than an authorization bypass.
evidence.observed: The Worker authenticates the current cookie, rechecks current POS/Sales permission, and stores the current authenticated actor. Client cashier_id is not authorization.

evidence.claim: Service-worker replay has the same ownership gap and can race foreground/session transitions.
evidence.observed: The worker reads all eligible sales:create rows, sends credentials:include, and uses only a timestamp lease. It has no scope comparison, claim token, or authenticated-owner check.

evidence.claim: Logout preserves durable stores but does not disable every replay path or relock the vault.
evidence.observed: Logout and unauthorized handling preserve offline stores/service worker. Maintenance starts when any stored session exists. Vault relock is idle/manual/tab-close only.

evidence.claim: Existing Cloudflare bootstrap cannot currently establish a complete hard runtime identity.
evidence.observed: Bootstrap returns runtime/database/storage kinds and organization null; storageVersion and dataRootKey are absent. User organization_public_id may exist, but there is no stable server data generation.

evidence.claim: Recommended durable row schema and classification.
evidence.locator: planned frontend/src/api/offlineWorkScope.ts and frontend/src/api/localDb.ts Dexie version 6
evidence.observed: Each new sync_queue, sync_outbox, and offline_file_chunks row should keep immutable origin_scope {protocolVersion:2, apiOrigin, organizationPublicId, dataGeneration, storageVersion, actorUserId, deviceId, scopeDigest}, scope_state, lease_token, lease_scope_digest, lease_expires_at, existing client_request_id, payload_digest, and ciphertext/payload bytes. Exact active scope is eligible; a different current actor/org/origin is held and hidden; a hard runtime transition is scope_quarantined; missing/invalid legacy scope is legacy_unattributed. Legacy and quarantined rows are never auto-replayed.

evidence.claim: Recommended server fence and rollout paths.
evidence.source: design inference from verified client/server race
evidence.locator: planned cloudflare/migrations/0137_offline_replay_generation.sql (recheck next free number after reserved 0136); cloudflare/src/lib/offlineReplayScope.ts; cloudflare/src/routes/auth.ts; cloudflare/src/routes/sync.ts; cloudflare/src/routes/sales.ts; cloudflare/src/routes/system.ts; cloudflare/src/routes/backups.ts; cloudflare/scripts/test-offline-replay-scope-pure.cjs; cloudflare/scripts/test-data-generation-pure.cjs
evidence.observed: Seed a random data_generation in system_flags, expose a stable protocol/storage version and server-computed scope digest at authenticated bootstrap, and validate raw scope fields plus digest against current actor/org/origin/generation before replay. Use new operation id sale.create.scoped.v2 so older Workers reject it as unsupported. Reject legacy sale.create outbox operations and direct /api/sales requests carrying offline created_at without a valid scope as a nonretrying conflict before reads/writes. Rotate data_generation before destructive reset/restore writes; a failed rotation leaves maintenance/reset blocked.

evidence.source: design inference from verified reset/logout flow
evidence.observed: Dexie version 6 adds [scope_digest+status] indexes without rewriting payload/ciphertext bytes and marks unscoped rows legacy_unattributed in the upgrade transaction. Persist active_scope metadata for both window and service worker. Establish it only after authoritative bootstrap. Clear it and relock the vault before logout/unauthorized transition. On hard runtime change, atomically quarantine matching durable rows first, then clear only disposable mirrors while preserving all durable stores; if quarantine fails, do not write the new runtime descriptor or apply the new bootstrap.

evidence.claim: Recommended replay, privacy, and recovery paths.
evidence.source: design inference from verified replay and preview surfaces
evidence.locator: planned frontend/src/api/saleWriteTransport.ts; frontend/src/api/pendingSyncTransport.ts; frontend/src/api/syncPreview.ts; frontend/src/api/syncRuntime.ts; frontend/src/public-runtime/service-worker.ts; frontend/public/sw.js; frontend/src/App.tsx; frontend/src/components/server/ServerPage.tsx
evidence.observed: Foreground and service worker atomically claim only exact-scope rows and condition ack/failure on lease token. Foreground sales replay uses /api/sync/outbox with sale.create.scoped.v2. Pending-state APIs return full items only for exact active scope and aggregate counts for held/quarantined rows, never entity labels or customer payloads to another user. Discard operates transactionally on an explicit scope/classification and reports failure if deletion fails. Quarantined/legacy work offers count, safe discard, and manual reconciliation guidance only; no automatic takeover or actor rewrite.

Every refused case asserts zero sale/stock/audit writes and preserved queue bytes/client_request_id.

evidence.source: design inference from existing backup/system_flags policy
evidence.observed: system_flags is intentionally excluded from backups, so the generation is live runtime state and must be rotated during restore. Migration is append-only INSERT OR IGNORE and preserves all business rows/schema. Rollout order is migration, backend guard/capability, then frontend/service worker. Rollback must retain the backend guard; scoped v2 operation IDs and versioned chunk endpoints fail closed on older code. IndexedDB version 6 is forward-only: rollback code must ignore retained extra fields/stores and must never clear or down-migrate durable rows.

risks: Client-only checks are insufficient because the authenticated cookie can change after a service-worker claim; server actor/org/generation validation is mandatory.

The current specialized sale queue is plaintext. Scope filtering prevents normal UI/replay disclosure across users, but browser-profile/DevTools access remains until a separate product decision enables encrypted POS queues.

The existing offline vault accepts any nonblank PIN and discovers a wrong PIN only during row decryption. A verifier plus scope-bound AES-GCM additionalData is recommended before recovery UI exposes encrypted work, but it is a separate bounded security slice.
A server mutation may commit before local acknowledgment. Quarantine/discard must distinguish outcome-unknown and reconcile by client_request_id; local discard cannot claim to undo a server commit.
Current Cloudflare bootstrap lacks stable data generation. Preserving queues without adding and rotating one cannot prove restore/data-root compatibility on other devices.
Migration number 0137 is provisional because 0136 is reserved outside the pinned base; the implementation owner must recheck the latest integrated migration before claiming a filename.
not_done: No application, migration, browser storage, production data, network, or remote state was changed.
No end-to-end browser IndexedDB loss, service-worker cookie-race, or real D1 migration was executed.
No automatic actor takeover was designed; manual reconciliation remains fail-closed and must record original recorder plus actual approver if later authorized.
No claim is made that the current Cloudflare bootstrap has caused observed production queue loss; its absent hard keys make the demonstrated reset path conditional.
handoff: Recommended decision: implement in three ordered slices. (1) Backend fence first: append-only generation seed, bootstrap scope capability, scoped-v2 replay validation, legacy offline replay rejection, and reset/restore generation rotation. (2) Client persistence: Dexie v6 scope metadata/indexes, legacy quarantine, active-scope lifecycle, hard-change quarantine-before-clear, logout relock. (3) Replay and recovery surfaces: exact-scope atomic claims in foreground/SW/generic outbox/chunks, privacy-filtered pending state, truthful scoped discard, and bilingual recovery status. Exact same actor+origin+organization+generation may resume automatically after authoritative bootstrap and current server permission checks; user/org mismatches are merely held and hidden so returning to the original exact scope can resume; hard-runtime and legacy rows require manual reconciliation or explicit discard. Do not enable operator takeover in this slice. Run the full acceptance matrix and both package typechecks/i18n/build after focused tests; independently verify the integrated backend-before-client rollout and rollback fence before deployment.
